parent_objective: source-weighted replay trajectory anchor to avoid global over-anchoring

public_gates: M183/M170 first replay if first gates pass
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower exact or replay thresholds
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not count retention-heavy projection as driver progress
hypothesis: Keeping M267/M264 replay pressure at effective 1e12 while increasing only old-key replay-failure rows to effective 1e13 can retain first proof gates with more recovery movement than global 1e13.
success_criteria: weighted anchor artifact contains 669 M267/M264 rows and 290 old-key rows
old-key anchor weights are multiplied by 10 while M267/M264 weights are unchanged
candidate passes M267/M264, old-key compact, and M183/M170 first proof gates
candidate retains at least 20% of M406 recovery improvement
failure_criteria: exact projection has positive exact regression
actor input or output contract changes

commands.name: source_weighted_replay_anchor_probe
commands.command: Create source-weighted combined anchor and run no-PPO exact repair with lambda_replay_trajectory_anchor=1e12, then run first proof gates and M412-style utility audit.

decision_rule: M414 may admit a full public gate only if proof gates pass and recovery-retention ratio is at least 0.20; otherwise classify the active failure and redesign toward an active-set hinge residual.
